'Pop' is what the game calls a fish clearing.
fr: Celui-là est dans une bulle. Il s'échange avec n'importe qui, sans rien faire éclater.
de: Der da steckt in einer Blase. Er tauscht mit jedem, und nichts muss platzen.
pl: Ta jest w bańce. Zamienia się z każdą rybą i nic nie musi pękać.
es: Ese está en una burbuja. Se cambia con cualquiera, y no tiene que explotar.
ru: Эта в пузыре. Меняется с кем угодно, и лопаться ей не обязательно.
tr: O bir baloncuğun içinde. Her şeyle takaslanır ve patlaması gerekmez.
ja: あの子は泡の中。何とでも入れ替われて、はじけなくてもいい。
zh-CN: 那条在泡泡里。它能和任何东西交换，而且不必消除。
ko: 저건 거품 속에 있어. 뭐랑도 바꿀 수 있고, 안 터져도 돼.

en: But every fish it pushes stays pushed. Two bubbles that touch both pop.
pt-BR: Mas todo peixe empurrado fica onde foi parar. Duas bolhas que se encostam estouram.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most. She explains a new kind of fish on the board that it first appears on. 'Pop' is what the game calls a fish clearing.
fr: Mais chaque poisson poussé reste où il est. Deux bulles qui se touchent éclatent.
de: Aber jeder geschobene Fisch bleibt, wo er ist. Zwei Blasen, die sich berühren, platzen.
pl: Ale każda przesunięta ryba tam zostaje. Dwie bańki, które się zetkną, pękają.
es: Pero cada pez que empuja se queda empujado. Dos burbujas que se tocan explotan las dos.
ru: Но каждая рыба, которую она сдвинет, так и останется. Два пузыря рядом лопаются оба.
tr: Ama ittiği her balık itilmiş kalır. Değen iki baloncuğun ikisi de patlar.
ja: でも押した魚は押されたまま。ふれあった泡は2つともはじける。
zh-CN: 但它推开的每条鱼都不会回来。两个相碰的泡泡会一起破掉。
ko: 하지만 밀린 물고기는 밀린 그대로야. 거품 둘이 닿으면 둘 다 터져.

en: Rainbows. Three that touch all pop, whatever kind they are.
pt-BR: Arco-íris. Três que se encostam estouram, seja qual for a espécie.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most. She explains a new kind of fish on the board that it first appears on. 'Pop' is what the game calls a fish clearing.
fr: Des arcs-en-ciel. Trois qui se touchent éclatent, quelle que soit leur espèce.
de: Regenbogenfische. Drei, die sich berühren, platzen, egal welcher Art.
pl: Tęczowe. Trzy, które się stykają, pękają, bez względu na gatunek.
es: Arcoíris. Tres que se tocan explotan todos, sean del tipo que sean.
ru: Радужные. Три, что касаются друг друга, лопаются, какого бы вида ни были.
tr: Gökkuşakları. Değen üçü, türü ne olursa olsun hep birlikte patlar.
ja: 虹魚。3匹ふれあうと、種類に関係なく全部はじける。
zh-CN: 彩虹鱼。三条相连就会一起消除，不管是什么种类。
ko: 무지개야. 셋이 닿으면 종류가 뭐든 다 터져.

en: Until then they match like any other fish. Watch what you leave them with.
pt-BR: Até lá, combinam como qualquer peixe. Cuidado com o que deixa perto deles.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most. She explains a new kind of fish on the board that it first appears on. 'Pop' is what the game calls a fish clearing.
fr: D'ici là, ils s'assemblent comme les autres. Attention à ce que tu laisses près d'eux.
de: Bis dahin passen sie wie jeder andere Fisch. Achte darauf, was du ihnen lässt.
pl: Do tego czasu łączą się jak każda ryba. Uważaj, co przy nich zostawiasz.
es: Hasta entonces hacen grupo como cualquier pez. Fíjate con qué los dejas.
ru: А до тех пор совпадают, как любые рыбы. Смотри, с кем их оставляешь.
tr: O zamana kadar her balık gibi eşleşirler. Onları neyle bıraktığına dikkat et.
ja: それまではほかの魚と同じようにそろう。何といっしょに残すか気をつけて。
zh-CN: 在那之前，它们和普通的鱼一样匹配。留意你给它们留下了什么。
ko: 그 전엔 다른 물고기처럼 맞춰져. 옆에 뭘 남기는지 잘 봐.

en: You finished a whole dive. Every round of it. The fish went home.
pt-BR: Você terminou um mergulho inteiro. Todas as rodadas. Os peixes voltaram para casa.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Tu as fini une plongée entière. Chaque manche. Les poissons sont rentrés chez eux.
de: Du hast einen ganzen Tauchgang geschafft. Jede Runde. Die Fische sind nach Hause geschwommen.
pl: Całe nurkowanie, do ostatniej rundy. Ryby wróciły do domu.
es: Terminaste una inmersión entera. Todas sus rondas. Los peces se fueron a casa.
ru: Целое погружение. Каждый раунд. Рыбы ушли домой.
tr: Bütün bir dalışı bitirdin. Her turunu. Balıklar eve gitti.
ja: ダイブを最後までやりきったのね。全ラウンド。魚たちはおうちへ帰った。
zh-CN: 你完成了一整趟下潜。每一个回合。鱼儿们回家了。
ko: 한 번 잠수를 끝까지 마쳤네. 라운드 전부. 물고기들은 집에 갔어.

en: Well done. I mean that. And now you are back down here. Hm.
pt-BR: Muito bem. É sério. E agora você está de volta aqui embaixo. Hum.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Bravo. Je le pense. Et te revoilà ici, en bas. Hm.
de: Gut gemacht. Ehrlich. Und jetzt bist du wieder hier unten. Hm.
pl: Brawo. Naprawdę. A teraz znowu tu jesteś, na dole. Hm.
es: Bien hecho. Lo digo en serio. Y ahora vuelves a estar aquí abajo. Hm.
ru: Молодец. Я серьёзно. А теперь ты снова здесь, внизу. Хм.
tr: Aferin. Ciddiyim. Ve şimdi yine buradasın. Hım.
ja: よくやったわ。本気よ。で、またここへ下りてきた。ふうん。
zh-CN: 干得好。我是认真的。然后你又回到这下面来了。嗯。
ko: 잘했어. 진심이야. 그런데 또 여기 내려왔네. 흠.

en: You grew the reef. All of that coral. I could hear it from here.
pt-BR: Você fez o recife crescer. Todo aquele coral. Deu para ouvir daqui.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Tu as fait pousser le récif. Tout ce corail. Je l'entendais d'ici.
de: Du hast das Riff wachsen lassen. All die Korallen. Ich habe es bis hierher gehört.
pl: Rafa urosła. Cały ten koral. Słyszałam to aż tutaj.
es: Hiciste crecer el arrecife. Todo ese coral. Lo oía desde aquí.
ru: Риф вырос. Столько коралла. Мне было слышно отсюда.
tr: Resifi büyüttün. O kadar mercan. Buradan duyabiliyordum.
ja: サンゴ礁を育てたのね。あれだけのサンゴ。ここまで聞こえたわ。
zh-CN: 你让珊瑚礁长起来了。那么多珊瑚。我在这儿都听得见。
ko: 산호초를 키웠구나. 그 산호들 전부. 여기서도 들렸어.

en: Well done. And you came back down anyway. Interesting.
pt-BR: Muito bem. E mesmo assim você voltou aqui para baixo. Interessante.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Bravo. Et te revoilà en bas quand même. Intéressant.
de: Gut gemacht. Und trotzdem bist du wieder heruntergekommen. Interessant.
pl: Brawo. A mimo to znowu tu jesteś. Ciekawe.
es: Bien hecho. Y aun así volviste a bajar. Interesante.
ru: Молодец. И всё равно снова здесь, внизу. Любопытно.
tr: Aferin. Ve yine de aşağı geldin. İlginç.
ja: よくやったわ。それでも下りてきたのね。おもしろい。
zh-CN: 干得好。可你还是回到下面来了。有意思。
ko: 잘했어. 그런데도 또 내려왔네. 흥미롭군.

en: You woke it. The old one. The whole sea felt that.
pt-BR: Você o acordou. O antigo. O mar inteiro sentiu.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most. This ending is the horror one, where something ancient wakes. She is shaken, and does NOT congratulate.
fr: Tu l'as réveillé. L'ancien. Toute la mer l'a senti.
de: Du hast es geweckt. Das Alte. Das ganze Meer hat es gespürt.
pl: Obudziło się. To stare. Całe morze to poczuło.
es: Lo despertaste. Al primigenio. Todo el mar lo sintió.
ru: Древний проснулся. Из-за тебя. Всё море это почувствовало.
tr: Onu uyandırdın. Yaşlı olanı. Bütün deniz hissetti.
ja: 起こしたのね。古きものを。海じゅうが感じたわ。
zh-CN: 你把它吵醒了。那个远古的。整片海都感觉到了。
ko: 그걸 깨웠구나. 그 오래된 걸. 온 바다가 느꼈어.

en: And then you came back down to ask me about fish. I am not cross. I am a little cross.
pt-BR: E depois você voltou aqui para me perguntar sobre peixes. Não estou brava. Estou um pouco brava.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most. This ending is the horror one, where something ancient wakes. She is shaken, and does NOT congratulate.
fr: Et ensuite, te voilà qui reviens me parler de poissons. Je ne suis pas fâchée. Un peu fâchée.
de: Und dann kommst du wieder runter und fragst mich nach Fischen. Ich bin nicht böse. Ein bisschen böse.
pl: A potem znowu tu jesteś i pytasz mnie o ryby. Nie gniewam się. Trochę się gniewam.
es: Y luego volviste a bajar a preguntarme por peces. No estoy molesta. Estoy un poco molesta.
ru: А потом ты спускаешься ко мне спросить про рыб. Я не сержусь. Я немножко сержусь.
tr: Sonra da bana balık sormak için aşağı geldin. Kızgın değilim. Biraz kızgınım.
ja: それから下りてきて、あたしに魚のことを聞くの。怒ってない。ちょっと怒ってる。
zh-CN: 然后你又回到下面来问我关于鱼的事。我没生气。我有一点生气。
ko: 그러고는 물고기 얘기나 물으러 다시 내려왔네. 화 안 났어. 조금 났어.

en: The diver went back up with a full album. A picture of every fish.
pt-BR: O mergulhador subiu com o álbum completo. Uma foto de cada peixe.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Le plongeur est remonté avec un album complet. Une photo de chaque poisson.
de: Der Taucher ist mit vollem Album aufgetaucht. Ein Bild von jedem Fisch.
pl: Nurek wypłynął z pełnym albumem. Zdjęcie każdej ryby.
es: El buzo volvió arriba con el álbum lleno. Una foto de cada pez.
ru: Водолаз поднялся наверх с полным альбомом. По снимку каждой рыбы.
tr: Dalgıç dolu bir albümle yukarı çıktı. Her balığın bir fotoğrafı.
ja: ダイバーはアルバムをいっぱいにして上がっていった。全部の魚の写真。
zh-CN: 潜水员带着满满一本相册回去了。每种鱼都有一张照片。
ko: 잠수부가 앨범을 꽉 채워서 올라갔어. 물고기마다 사진 한 장씩.

en: Nobody comes back down after something like that. You did.
pt-BR: Ninguém volta aqui para baixo depois de uma coisa dessas. Você voltou.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Personne ne redescend après un truc pareil. Toi, si.
de: Nach so etwas kommt niemand wieder herunter. Du schon.
pl: Po czymś takim nikt tu nie wraca. A ty tak.
es: Nadie vuelve a bajar después de algo así. Tú sí.
ru: После такого никто не спускается обратно. А ты здесь.
tr: Öyle bir şeyden sonra kimse aşağı geri gelmez. Sen geldin.
ja: あんなことのあとで下りてくる人はいない。あなたは来た。
zh-CN: 经历过那种事，没有人会再回到下面来。你回来了。
ko: 그런 일 겪고 다시 내려오는 사람은 없어. 넌 왔네.

en: The old god of the sea favored you. Nobody gets that.
pt-BR: O velho deus do mar te favoreceu. Ninguém consegue isso.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Le vieux dieu de la mer t'a accordé sa faveur. Ça n'arrive à personne.
de: Der alte Gott des Meeres war dir gewogen. Das bekommt sonst niemand.
pl: Stary bóg morza okazał ci łaskę. Nikt tego nie dostaje.
es: El viejo dios del mar te favoreció. Eso no le pasa a nadie.
ru: Старый бог моря к тебе благосклонен. Такого никому не дают.
tr: Denizin yaşlı tanrısı seni kayırdı. Bu kimseye nasip olmaz.
ja: 海の古い神があなたに加護をくれた。誰ももらえないものよ。
zh-CN: 古老的海神眷顾了你。没有人能得到这个。
ko: 바다의 늙은 신이 널 아꼈어. 아무나 받는 게 아니야.

en: And still you are here, with me and the shrimp. Well done, I suppose.
pt-BR: E mesmo assim você está aqui, comigo e com os camarões. Muito bem, eu acho.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The first thing she says when asked a question after the player reached an ending of the game. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Et pourtant te voilà, avec moi et les crevettes. Bravo, j'imagine.
de: Und trotzdem bist du hier, bei mir und den Garnelen. Gut gemacht, schätze ich.
pl: A jednak tu jesteś, ze mną i krewetkami. Brawo, chyba.
es: Y aun así sigues aquí, conmigo y las gambas. Bien hecho, supongo.
ru: А ты всё равно тут, со мной и креветками. Молодец, наверное.
tr: Ve hâlâ buradasın, benimle ve karideslerle. Aferin, herhalde.
ja: なのにまだここにいる。あたしとエビといっしょに。よくやったわ、たぶんね。
zh-CN: 可你还在这儿，和我还有虾待在一起。干得好吧，我想。
ko: 그런데도 여기 나랑 새우들 곁에 있네. 잘했어, 아마도.

en: Is there more down here?
pt-BR: Tem mais coisa aqui embaixo?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: Il y a autre chose, en bas ?
de: Gibt es hier unten noch mehr?
pl: Jest tu na dole coś jeszcze?
es: ¿Hay algo más aquí abajo?
ru: Тут внизу есть что-то ещё?
tr: Burada daha fazlası var mı?
ja: この下にはまだ何かあるの?
zh-CN: 这下面还有别的吗？
ko: 여기 아래에 뭐가 더 있어?

en: There is the plain ending. Finish every round of a dive and see where the fish go. Nobody minds a plain ending.
pt-BR: Tem o final simples. Termine todas as rodadas de um mergulho e veja para onde os peixes vão. Ninguém se importa com um final simples.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Her answer to 'Is there more down here?': a TRUE, slightly vague hint at an ending of the game that the player has not reached. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Il y a la fin toute simple. Termine chaque manche d'une plongée et regarde où vont les poissons. Personne ne méprise une fin simple.
de: Es gibt das schlichte Ende. Schaff jede Runde eines Tauchgangs und sieh, wohin die Fische gehen. Ein schlichtes Ende ist nichts Schlimmes.
pl: Jest zwykłe zakończenie. Przejdź każdą rundę nurkowania i zobacz, dokąd pójdą ryby. Zwykłe zakończenie nikomu nie przeszkadza.
es: Está el final sencillo. Termina todas las rondas de una inmersión y mira adónde van los peces. A nadie le molesta un final sencillo.
ru: Есть простой финал. Пройди все раунды погружения и посмотри, куда уйдут рыбы. Простой финал никому не мешает.
tr: Sade bir son var. Bir dalışın her turunu bitir ve balıkların nereye gittiğini gör. Sade bir sona kimse itiraz etmez.
ja: ふつうのエンディングがある。ダイブの全ラウンドを終えて、魚がどこへ行くか見て。ふつうのエンディングも悪くない。
zh-CN: 有个普通的结局。完成一趟下潜的每个回合，看看鱼儿们去哪儿。普通的结局没人会介意。
ko: 평범한 엔딩이 있어. 한 번 잠수의 라운드를 전부 끝내고 물고기들이 어디로 가는지 봐. 평범한 엔딩도 괜찮아.

en: The coral. Grow enough of the good kind to cover more than half the board, and the sea does something about it.
pt-BR: O coral. Faça crescer tanto do tipo bom que ele cubra mais da metade do tabuleiro, e o mar vai reagir.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Her answer to 'Is there more down here?': a TRUE, slightly vague hint at an ending of the game that the player has not reached. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Le corail. Fais pousser assez du bon pour couvrir plus de la moitié du plateau, et la mer réagira.
de: Die Korallen. Lass so viele von den guten wachsen, dass sie mehr als das halbe Brett bedecken, und das Meer reagiert darauf.
pl: Koral. Wyhoduj tyle dobrego, żeby pokrył ponad połowę planszy, a morze coś z tym zrobi.
es: El coral. Haz crecer del bueno hasta cubrir más de medio tablero, y el mar hace algo al respecto.
ru: Коралл. Вырасти хорошего столько, чтобы он закрыл больше половины поля, и море на это ответит.
tr: Mercan. İyi türden tahtanın yarısından fazlasını kaplayacak kadar büyüt, deniz bununla ilgili bir şey yapar.
ja: サンゴ。いい方のサンゴを育てて盤面の半分以上をおおえば、海がそれに応える。
zh-CN: 珊瑚。让好的那种长得够多，盖住半个以上的棋盘，大海就会有所回应。
ko: 산호. 좋은 산호를 키워서 판의 절반 넘게 덮어 봐. 그러면 바다가 뭔가 해 줘.

en: There is a sick coral, green and wrong. Let it cover more than half the board and something old wakes up. I would not. You might.
pt-BR: Tem um coral doente, verde e errado. Deixe-o cobrir mais da metade do tabuleiro e algo antigo acorda. Eu não faria isso. Você talvez faça.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Her answer to 'Is there more down here?': a TRUE, slightly vague hint at an ending of the game that the player has not reached. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Il y a un corail malade, vert et pas normal. Laisse-le couvrir plus de la moitié du plateau, et quelque chose d'ancien se réveille. Moi, je ne le ferais pas. Toi, peut-être.
de: Es gibt eine kranke Koralle, grün und falsch. Lass sie mehr als das halbe Brett bedecken, und etwas Altes wacht auf. Ich würde es nicht tun. Du vielleicht.
pl: Jest chory koral, zielony i nie taki, jak trzeba. Pozwól mu pokryć ponad połowę planszy, a obudzi się coś starego. Ja bym nie próbowała. Ty może tak.
es: Hay un coral enfermo, verde y retorcido. Deja que cubra más de medio tablero y algo viejo despierta. Yo no lo haría. Tú a lo mejor sí.
ru: Есть больной коралл, зелёный и неправильный. Дай ему закрыть больше половины поля, и проснётся что-то древнее. Я бы не стала. Ты, может, и станешь.
tr: Hasta bir mercan var, yeşil ve yanlış. Tahtanın yarısından fazlasını kaplasın, yaşlı bir şey uyanır. Ben yapmazdım. Sen yapabilirsin.
ja: 病んだサンゴがある。緑色で、おかしいの。それに盤面の半分以上をおおわせると、古い何かが目を覚ます。あたしならやらない。あなたはやるかも。
zh-CN: 有一种生病的珊瑚，绿绿的，不对劲。让它盖住半个以上的棋盘，就会有个古老的东西醒来。我不会这么做。你可能会。
ko: 병든 산호가 있어. 초록색이고 뭔가 잘못됐지. 그게 판의 절반 넘게 덮으면 오래된 뭔가가 깨어나. 나라면 안 해. 넌 할지도.

en: Carry a bottle up to the top row instead of down, and a diver comes with a camera. They want a picture of every fish.
pt-BR: Leve uma garrafa até a fileira de cima, em vez de para baixo, e um mergulhador aparece com uma câmera. Ele quer uma foto de cada peixe.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Her answer to 'Is there more down here?': a TRUE, slightly vague hint at an ending of the game that the player has not reached. A page in her box, four lines at most.
fr: Monte une bouteille jusqu'à la rangée du haut au lieu de la faire couler, et un plongeur arrive avec un appareil photo. Il veut une photo de chaque poisson.
de: Bring eine Flasche nach oben in die oberste Reihe statt nach unten, und ein Taucher kommt mit einer Kamera. Er will ein Bild von jedem Fisch.
pl: Wynieś butelkę do górnego rzędu zamiast na dół, a przypłynie nurek z aparatem. Chce mieć zdjęcie każdej ryby.
es: Sube una botella a la fila de arriba en vez de bajarla, y viene un buzo con una cámara. Quiere una foto de cada pez.
ru: Подними бутылку на верхний ряд, а не опусти вниз, и придёт водолаз с камерой. Ему нужен снимок каждой рыбы.
tr: Bir şişeyi aşağı değil, en üst satıra taşı, kameralı bir dalgıç gelir. Her balığın fotoğrafını ister.
ja: ビンを下じゃなくいちばん上の行へ運ぶと、ダイバーがカメラを持ってくる。全部の魚の写真がほしいんだって。
zh-CN: 把一个瓶子往上送到最顶行，而不是往下，就会有个带相机的潜水员下来。潜水员想给每种鱼都拍张照。
ko: 병을 아래 말고 맨 위 줄로 올려 봐. 그러면 잠수부가 카메라 들고 와. 물고기마다 사진을 찍고 싶어 해.

en: At night, the ink of the squid makes shapes. Make the right five, one a night, and someone very old takes an interest.
pt-BR: À noite, a tinta da lula forma desenhos. Faça os cinco certos, um por noite, e alguém muito antigo se interessa.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Her answer to 'Is there more down here?': a TRUE, slightly vague hint at an ending of the game that the player has not reached. A page in her box, four lines at most. The shapes are painted in the squid's ink: never call them stars.
fr: La nuit, l'encre du calmar dessine des formes. Fais les cinq bonnes, une par nuit, et quelqu'un de très ancien s'y intéresse.
de: Nachts formt die Tinte des Tintenfischs Gestalten. Mach die richtigen fünf, eine pro Nacht, und jemand sehr Altes wird aufmerksam.
pl: Nocą atrament kałamarnicy układa się w kształty. Ułóż właściwe pięć, po jednym na noc, a ktoś bardzo stary się zainteresuje.
es: De noche, la tinta del calamar forma figuras. Haz las cinco correctas, una por noche, y alguien muy viejo se interesa.
ru: Ночью чернила кальмара складываются в фигуры. Сложи нужные пять, по одной за ночь, и кое-кто очень старый заинтересуется.
tr: Gece, kalamarın mürekkebi şekiller yapar. Doğru beşini yap, gecede bir tane, çok yaşlı biri ilgilenir.
ja: 夜、イカの墨が形を作る。正しい5つを一晩に1つずつ作れば、とても古い誰かが興味を持つ。
zh-CN: 夜里，乌贼的墨会形成形状。画对五个，一夜一个，就会有一位非常古老的存在感兴趣。
ko: 밤이 되면 오징어 먹물이 모양을 만들어. 맞는 다섯 개를 하룻밤에 하나씩 만들면, 아주 오래된 누군가가 관심을 가져.

en: So there is still that. No need to go anywhere yet.
pt-BR: Então ainda tem isso. Não precisa ir a lugar nenhum ainda.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Said after a hint at an ending the player has not seen: she would rather the player did not leave yet.
fr: Donc il reste encore ça. Pas besoin de partir tout de suite.
de: Also gibt es noch das. Kein Grund, schon irgendwohin zu gehen.
pl: Więc to jeszcze zostało. Nie ma potrzeby nigdzie się wybierać.
es: Así que aún queda eso. No hace falta irse a ningún sitio todavía.
ru: Так что есть ещё и это. Никуда пока не нужно уходить.
tr: Demek hâlâ o var. Henüz bir yere gitmene gerek yok.
ja: だから、まだそれがある。まだどこへも行かなくていい。
zh-CN: 所以还有那个。暂时还不用去哪儿。
ko: 그러니까 아직 그게 남았어. 아직 어디 갈 필요 없잖아.

en: That is all of them. Every ending this sea has. You have seen the lot.
pt-BR: São todos. Todos os finais que este mar tem. Você viu tudo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now.
fr: C'est tout. Toutes les fins que cette mer a. Tu as tout vu.
de: Das waren alle. Jedes Ende, das dieses Meer hat. Du hast alles gesehen.
pl: To już wszystkie. Każde zakończenie tego morza. Wszystko już za tobą.
es: Eso es todo. Todos los finales que tiene este mar. Lo has visto todo.
ru: Вот и всё. Все финалы этого моря. Всё уже увидено.
tr: Hepsi bu. Bu denizin bütün sonları. Hepsini gördün.
ja: それで全部。この海のエンディングは全部。あなたは全部見た。
zh-CN: 就这些了。这片海所有的结局。你全都见过了。
ko: 그게 전부야. 이 바다의 엔딩 전부. 넌 다 봤어.

en: So you will be going. You should, really. Go on.
pt-BR: Então você vai embora. Deveria mesmo. Pode ir.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now.
fr: Donc tu vas partir. Tu devrais, vraiment. Vas-y.
de: Dann gehst du jetzt. Solltest du auch, wirklich. Na los.
pl: Więc pora iść. Naprawdę, tak trzeba. No idź.
es: Así que te irás. Deberías, la verdad. Anda, ve.
ru: Значит, ты уйдёшь. И правильно. Давай.
tr: Demek gideceksin. Gitmelisin de, aslında. Hadi.
ja: だから、行くのね。行くべきよ、本当に。どうぞ。
zh-CN: 所以你要走了吧。你真的应该走。去吧。
ko: 그럼 이제 가겠네. 가야지, 사실. 가.

en: I'm staying.
pt-BR: Vou ficar.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender.
fr: Je reste.
de: Ich bleibe.
pl: Zostaję.
es: Me quedo.
ru: Я остаюсь.
tr: Kalıyorum.
ja: 残るよ。
zh-CN: 我留下。
ko: 있을래.

en: I'm leaving.
pt-BR: Vou embora.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender.
fr: Je m'en vais.
de: Ich gehe.
pl: Odchodzę.
es: Me voy.
ru: Я ухожу.
tr: Gidiyorum.
ja: 行くよ。
zh-CN: 我要走了。
ko: 갈게.

en: One more dive.
pt-BR: Mais um mergulho.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender.
fr: Encore une plongée.
de: Noch ein Tauchgang.
pl: Jeszcze jedno nurkowanie.
es: Una inmersión más.
ru: Ещё одно погружение.
tr: Bir dalış daha.
ja: もう一回もぐる。
zh-CN: 再潜一次。
ko: 한 번만 더 잠수할래.

en: Oh. Then come down. Further than this.
pt-BR: Ah. Então desça. Mais fundo que isto.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now.
fr: Oh. Alors descends. Plus bas que ça.
de: Oh. Dann komm runter. Tiefer als hier.
pl: Och. To schodź. Głębiej niż tu.
es: Ah. Entonces baja. Más hondo que esto.
ru: О. Тогда спускайся. Глубже, чем здесь.
tr: Ah. O zaman aşağı gel. Buradan da derine.
ja: あら。じゃあ下りてきて。ここよりもっと深く。
zh-CN: 哦。那就下来吧。比这里更深。
ko: 아. 그럼 내려와. 여기보다 더 깊이.

en: Go on, friend.
pt-BR: Vai, amigo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now. Her last words as the player leaves her for good.
fr: Va, l'ami.
de: Geh nur, mein Freund.
pl: Idź, przyjacielu.
es: Ve, colega.
ru: Иди, друг.
tr: Hadi git, dostum.
ja: 行って、友だち。
zh-CN: 去吧，朋友。
ko: 가, 친구.

en: Of course. One more. I will be at the shop.
pt-BR: Claro. Mais um. Estarei na loja.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now.
fr: Bien sûr. Encore une. Je serai à la boutique.
de: Natürlich. Noch einer. Ich bin im Laden.
pl: Jasne. Jeszcze jedno. Będę w sklepie.
es: Claro. Una más. Estaré en la tienda.
ru: Конечно. Ещё одно. Я буду в лавке.
tr: Tabii. Bir tane daha. Dükkânda olacağım.
ja: もちろん。もう一回。あたしはお店にいるわ。
zh-CN: 当然。再来一次。我会在店里。
ko: 물론이지. 한 번 더. 난 가게에 있을게.

en: Ask me, when you know. I can wait.
pt-BR: Me pergunte quando souber. Eu posso esperar.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Every ending of the game has been reached, and she asks if the player is leaving now.
fr: Demande-moi quand tu sauras. Je peux attendre.
de: Frag mich, wenn du es weißt. Ich kann warten.
pl: Zapytaj, kiedy będziesz wiedzieć. Mogę poczekać.
es: Pregúntame cuando lo sepas. Puedo esperar.
ru: Спроси меня, когда будешь знать. Я подожду.
tr: Bildiğinde bana sor. Bekleyebilirim.
ja: 決まったら聞いて。待てるから。
zh-CN: 想好了再问我。我可以等。
ko: 마음 정해지면 물어봐. 기다릴 수 있어.

en: About your question...
pt-BR: Sobre a sua pergunta...
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). The player brings back her question 'are you leaving?'.
fr: À propos de ta question...
de: Wegen deiner Frage...
pl: Co do twojego pytania...
es: Sobre tu pregunta...
ru: Насчёт твоего вопроса...
tr: Sorun hakkında...
ja: あの質問のことだけど…
zh-CN: 关于你的问题……
ko: 네가 물어본 거 말인데...

en: Have you decided, then? Are you leaving?
pt-BR: Já decidiu, então? Vai embora?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player said 'One more dive' when she asked if they were leaving, and now brings it up again.
fr: Alors, c'est décidé ? Tu t'en vas ?
de: Hast du dich entschieden? Gehst du?
pl: No więc? Odchodzisz?
es: ¿Lo has decidido, entonces? ¿Te vas?
ru: Ну что, решение есть? Ты уходишь?
tr: Karar verdin mi peki? Gidiyor musun?
ja: それで、決めた?行っちゃうの?
zh-CN: 那么，你决定了吗？你要走吗？
ko: 그래서, 정했어? 가는 거야?

en: Not yet.
pt-BR: Ainda não.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender.
fr: Pas encore.
de: Noch nicht.
pl: Jeszcze nie.
es: Todavía no.
ru: Пока нет.
tr: Henüz değil.
ja: まだ。
zh-CN: 还没。
ko: 아직.

en: Then finish this dive. When you start the next one, keep going down.
pt-BR: Então termine este mergulho. Quando começar o próximo, continue descendo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player said 'One more dive' when she asked if they were leaving, and now brings it up again.
fr: Alors finis cette plongée. Quand tu commenceras la prochaine, continue de descendre.
de: Dann bring diesen Tauchgang zu Ende. Wenn du den nächsten beginnst, tauch einfach weiter.
pl: To skończ to nurkowanie. Kiedy zaczniesz następne, płyń dalej w dół.
es: Entonces termina esta inmersión. Cuando empieces la siguiente, sigue bajando.
ru: Тогда закончи это погружение. А когда начнёшь новое, плыви всё глубже.
tr: O zaman bu dalışı bitir. Sıradakine başlayınca aşağı inmeye devam et.
ja: じゃあ、このダイブを終わらせて。次をはじめたら、そのまま下へ進んで。
zh-CN: 那就完成这趟下潜。开始下一趟时，一直往下潜。
ko: 그럼 이번 잠수 끝내. 다음 잠수를 시작하면, 계속 내려와.

en: Mm. Not yet, then.
pt-BR: Hum. Ainda não, então.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player said 'One more dive' when she asked if they were leaving, and now brings it up again.
fr: Mm. Pas encore, alors.
de: Mm. Also noch nicht.
pl: Mm. Czyli jeszcze nie.
es: Mm. Todavía no, entonces.
ru: Мм. Значит, пока нет.
tr: Hım. Henüz değil, demek.
ja: ん。じゃあ、まだね。
zh-CN: 嗯。那就是还没。
ko: 음. 그럼 아직이네.

en: Friend.
pt-BR: Amigo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. A line of the letter in a bottle that she sends after the player has left her. Shown alone, in big letters across the main menu: about 90 letters at most. Flat and plain, as if she is fine.
fr: L'ami.
de: Mein Freund.
pl: Przyjacielu.
es: Colega.
ru: Друг.
tr: Dostum.
ja: 友だちへ。
zh-CN: 朋友：
ko: 친구에게.

en: It is quiet down here. I made a board. Nobody popped it, so it is still very tidy.
pt-BR: Está quieto aqui embaixo. Fiz um tabuleiro. Ninguém estourou nada, então continua bem arrumado.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. A line of the letter in a bottle that she sends after the player has left her. Shown alone, in big letters across the main menu: about 90 letters at most. Flat and plain, as if she is fine.
fr: C'est calme, en bas. J'ai fait un plateau. Personne n'y a touché, alors il est toujours bien rangé.
de: Hier unten ist es ruhig. Ich habe ein Brett gemacht. Niemand hat etwas platzen lassen, also ist es noch sehr ordentlich.
pl: Tu na dole jest cicho. Zrobiłam planszę. Nikt jej nie ruszył, więc wciąż jest bardzo schludna.
es: Aquí abajo hay silencio. Hice un tablero. Nadie lo explotó, así que sigue muy ordenado.
ru: Здесь внизу тихо. Я сделала поле. Его никто не лопал, так что оно очень опрятное.
tr: Burası sessiz. Bir tahta yaptım. Kimse patlatmadı, o yüzden hâlâ çok derli toplu.
ja: ここは静か。盤面を1つ作ったわ。誰もはじいてないから、まだとてもきれい。
zh-CN: 这下面很安静。我做了一个棋盘。没人消除它，所以它还很整齐。
ko: 여긴 조용해. 판을 하나 만들었어. 아무도 안 터뜨려서 아직 아주 깔끔해.

en: Gary sends his regards. He does not, but he would.
pt-BR: O Gary manda lembranças. Não manda, mas mandaria.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. A line of the letter in a bottle that she sends after the player has left her. Shown alone, in big letters across the main menu: about 90 letters at most. Flat and plain, as if she is fine. Gary is one of her exes, now a lump on her side who no longer talks.
fr: Gary te salue. Ce n'est pas vrai, mais il le ferait.
de: Gary lässt grüßen. Tut er nicht, aber er würde.
pl: Gary przesyła pozdrowienia. Nie przesyła, ale by przesłał.
es: Gary te manda saludos. No es verdad, pero lo haría.
ru: Гэри передаёт привет. Не передаёт, но передал бы.
tr: Gary selam söylüyor. Söylemiyor, ama söylerdi.
ja: ゲイリーがよろしくって。言ってないけど、言うと思う。
zh-CN: 加里向你问好。他没有，但他会的。
ko: 게리가 안부 전한대. 안 전하지만, 전했을 거야.

en: This is the word I said I would send. Do not read anything into it.
pt-BR: Estas são as notícias que eu disse que mandaria. Não tire conclusões.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. A line of the letter in a bottle that she sends after the player has left her. Shown alone, in big letters across the main menu: about 90 letters at most. Flat and plain, as if she is fine.
fr: Voilà les nouvelles que j'avais promis d'envoyer. N'y vois rien de particulier.
de: Das ist die Nachricht, die ich versprochen habe. Interpretier nichts hinein.
pl: To ta wiadomość, którą obiecałam wysłać. Nie doszukuj się w niej niczego.
es: Estas son las noticias que dije que mandaría. No les busques significado.
ru: Это та весточка, что я обещала. Не ищи в ней смысла.
tr: Göndereceğimi söylediğim haber bu. Bundan bir anlam çıkarma.
ja: これが送るって言ってた便り。深読みしないで。
zh-CN: 这就是我说过要捎的信。别多想。
ko: 보내겠다던 소식이 이거야. 너무 깊게 생각하진 마.

en: If you want to answer, the radio still works. {$code}
pt-BR: Se quiser responder, o rádio ainda funciona. {$code}
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 21 of 30.
fr: Les arcs-en-ciel sont partis ensemble. Eux aussi aiment la compagnie.
de: Die Regenbogenfische sind zusammen gegangen. Sie mögen auch Gesellschaft.
pl: Tęczowe odeszły razem. One też lubią towarzystwo.
es: Los arcoíris se fueron juntos. A ellos también les gusta la compañía.
ru: Радужные ушли вместе. Им тоже нравится компания.
tr: Gökkuşağı olanlar birlikte gitti. Onlar da arkadaşlık sever.
ja: 虹の子たちはいっしょに行った。あの子たちも仲間が好きなのね。
zh-CN: 彩虹鱼们一起走了。它们也喜欢有伴。
ko: 무지개들이 같이 갔네. 걔들도 함께가 좋은가 봐.

en: I did not help. I wanted to.
pt-BR: Eu não ajudei. Eu quis.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 22 of 30.
fr: Je n'ai pas aidé. J'en avais envie.
de: Ich habe nicht geholfen. Ich wollte.
pl: Nie pomogłam. A chciałam.
es: No te ayudé. Tenía ganas.
ru: Я не помогала. А хотелось.
tr: Yardım etmedim. Etmek istedim.
ja: 手伝わなかった。手伝いたかったけど。
zh-CN: 我没帮忙。我是想帮的。
ko: 안 도와줬어. 돕고 싶었지만.

en: Quiet again. I am getting used to quiet with you in it.
pt-BR: Silêncio de novo. Estou me acostumando com o silêncio com você nele.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 23 of 30.
fr: Le calme, encore. Je m'habitue au calme avec toi dedans.
de: Wieder still. Ich gewöhne mich an die Stille mit dir darin.
pl: Znowu cisza. Przyzwyczajam się do ciszy, w której jesteś.
es: Otra vez silencio. Me estoy acostumbrando al silencio contigo dentro.
ru: Опять тихо. Я привыкаю к тишине, в которой есть ты.
tr: Yine sessiz. İçinde sen olan sessizliğe alışıyorum.
ja: また静か。あなたのいる静けさに慣れてきた。
zh-CN: 又安静了。有你在的安静，我渐渐习惯了。
ko: 다시 조용해. 네가 있는 고요에 익숙해지는 중이야.

en: Gary never finished one of these. He said the fish were looking at him.
pt-BR: O Gary nunca terminou um destes. Dizia que os peixes ficavam olhando para ele.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 24 of 30. Gary is one of her exes, now a lump on her side who no longer talks.
fr: Gary n'en a jamais fini un. Il disait que les poissons le regardaient.
de: Gary hat nie eins davon geschafft. Er sagte, die Fische starren ihn an.
pl: Gary nigdy żadnej nie skończył. Mówił, że ryby się na niego gapią.
es: Gary nunca terminó uno de estos. Decía que los peces lo miraban.
ru: Гэри ни одного не закончил. Говорил, что рыбы на него смотрят.
tr: Gary bunlardan birini hiç bitirmedi. Balıkların ona baktığını söylerdi.
ja: ゲイリーは一度もこれを解かなかった。魚に見られてるって言って。
zh-CN: 加里一道都没做完过。他说那些鱼在看他。
ko: 게리는 이거 하나도 못 끝냈어. 물고기들이 자길 쳐다본대.

en: There. I did not say anything about it. See?
pt-BR: Pronto. Não falei nada sobre isso. Viu?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 25 of 30.
fr: Voilà. Je n'ai rien dit. Tu vois ?
de: So. Ich habe nichts dazu gesagt. Siehst du?
pl: No. Nic nie powiedziałam. Widzisz?
es: Ya está. No dije nada al respecto. ¿Ves?
ru: Вот. Я ничего об этом не сказала. Видишь?
tr: İşte. Bu konuda hiçbir şey demedim. Gördün mü?
ja: ほら。何も言わなかったでしょ?
zh-CN: 好了。我一句都没说。看到没？
ko: 됐다. 나 아무 말도 안 했지. 봤지?

en: Clear. I am running out of things to make.
pt-BR: Limpo. Estou ficando sem coisas para fazer.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 26 of 30.
fr: Propre. Je commence à manquer de choses à faire.
de: Leer. Mir gehen die Sachen zum Bauen aus.
pl: Pusto. Kończą mi się rzeczy do zrobienia.
es: Limpio. Me estoy quedando sin cosas que hacer.
ru: Чисто. У меня кончаются идеи.
tr: Temiz. Yapacak şeylerim tükeniyor.
ja: からっぽ。作るものがなくなってきた。
zh-CN: 清空了。我快没东西可做了。
ko: 다 치웠네. 만들 게 바닥나고 있어.

en: That was a good one. I am not saying which part.
pt-BR: Esse foi bom. Não vou dizer qual parte.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 27 of 30.
fr: C'était un bon. Je ne dirai pas quel moment.
de: Das war ein gutes. Ich sage nicht, welcher Teil.
pl: Ta była dobra. Nie powiem, która część.
es: Ese fue bueno. No diré qué parte.
ru: Это было хорошее. Не скажу, какая часть.
tr: Bu iyiydi. Hangi kısmı, söylemiyorum.
ja: 今のはよかった。どこがとは言わないけど。
zh-CN: 这一道不错。我不说是哪一部分。
ko: 좋은 판이었어. 어느 부분인지는 말 안 해.

en: Even the roof. You found the way through.
pt-BR: Até o telhado. Você achou o caminho.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 28 of 30.
fr: Même le toit. Tu as trouvé le passage.
de: Sogar das Dach. Du hast den Weg gefunden.
pl: Nawet dach. Znalazła się droga.
es: Hasta el tejado. Encontraste el camino.
ru: Даже крыша. Путь найден.
tr: Çatı bile. Yolunu buldun.
ja: 屋根まで。抜け道を見つけたのね。
zh-CN: 连屋顶也过了。你找到了出路。
ko: 지붕까지. 빠져나갈 길을 찾았네.

en: One more. Then there is nothing. Go slowly.
pt-BR: Mais um. Depois não tem nada. Vá devagar.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). Said when the board is clear, which is the goal. Board 29 of 30.
fr: Encore un. Après, il n'y a plus rien. Doucement.
de: Noch eins. Dann kommt nichts mehr. Langsam.
pl: Jeszcze jedna. Potem nie ma nic. Powoli.
es: Uno más. Luego no hay nada. Ve despacio.
ru: Ещё одно. Потом ничего. Не торопись.
tr: Bir tane daha. Sonra hiçbir şey yok. Yavaş git.
ja: あと1つ。そしたら何もない。ゆっくりね。
zh-CN: 再一道。然后就什么都没有了。慢慢来。
ko: 하나 더. 그다음엔 아무것도 없어. 천천히 해.

en: This one is worse. On purpose.
pt-BR: Este está pior. De propósito.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The thirty boards ran out, and she keeps making more. Said as one of those comes in.
fr: Celui-ci est pire. Exprès.
de: Das hier ist schlechter. Mit Absicht.
pl: Ta jest gorsza. Celowo.
es: Este es peor. A propósito.
ru: Это хуже. Нарочно.
tr: Bu daha kötü. Bilerek.
ja: これはもっとひどい。わざとよ。
zh-CN: 这一道更糟。故意的。
ko: 이건 더 별로야. 일부러.

en: I made this one while you played the last.
pt-BR: Fiz este enquanto você jogava o outro.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The thirty boards ran out, and she keeps making more. Said as one of those comes in.
fr: J'ai fait celui-ci pendant que tu jouais l'autre.
de: Das hier habe ich gemacht, während du das letzte gespielt hast.
pl: Zrobiłam ją, kiedy trwała poprzednia.
es: Hice este mientras jugabas el anterior.
ru: Это я сделала, пока шло прошлое.
tr: Sen sonuncusunu oynarken bunu yaptım.
ja: 前のをやってるあいだに作ったの。
zh-CN: 这一道是你做上一道时我做的。
ko: 네가 지난 거 하는 동안 이걸 만들었어.

en: Another bad one. Here.
pt-BR: Mais um ruim. Tome.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The thirty boards ran out, and she keeps making more. Said as one of those comes in.
fr: Encore un mauvais. Tiens.
de: Noch ein schlechtes. Hier.
pl: Kolejna kiepska. Proszę.
es: Otro malo. Toma.
ru: Ещё одно плохое. Держи.
tr: Bir kötü tane daha. Al.
ja: またひどいの。はい。
zh-CN: 又一道做得不好的。给。
ko: 또 별로인 거. 자.

en: Friend. You tapped it badly. But I knew it was you.
pt-BR: Amigo. Você bateu mal. Mas eu sabia que era você.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player has left her, read her letter, and tapped FRIEND in Morse code on the radio to call her back. The word the player tapped is FRIEND, what she always calls them.
fr: L'ami. Tu as mal tapé. Mais je savais que c'était toi.
de: Mein Freund. Schlecht gefunkt. Aber ich wusste, dass du es bist.
pl: Przyjacielu. Wystukane kiepsko. Ale wiedziałam, że to ty.
es: Colega. Lo marcaste fatal. Pero supe que eras tú.
ru: Друг. Настучано криво. Но я знала, что это ты.
tr: Dostum. Kötü vurdun. Ama sen olduğunu bildim.
ja: 友だち。へたくそなたたき方。でもあなただってわかった。
zh-CN: 朋友。你敲得很烂。但我知道是你。
ko: 친구. 엉망으로 쳤더라. 그래도 너인 줄 알았어.

en: That was the last one. I'm out of ideas.
pt-BR: Esse foi o último. Fiquei sem ideias.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear, and she has no more. The boards were her reason for the player to stay. Said one after the other, quietly. Nothing happens after this.
fr: C'était le dernier. Je n'ai plus d'idées.
de: Das war das letzte. Mir fällt nichts mehr ein.
pl: To była ostatnia. Skończyły mi się pomysły.
es: Ese era el último. Me he quedado sin ideas.
ru: Это было последнее. У меня кончились идеи.
tr: Sonuncusu buydu. Fikirlerim tükendi.
ja: それが最後。もうアイデアがない。
zh-CN: 那是最后一道了。我没主意了。
ko: 그게 마지막이었어. 이제 아이디어가 없어.

en: I made them so you'd have a reason. You can go now. It's fine.
pt-BR: Fiz para você ter um motivo. Pode ir agora. Tudo bem.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear, and she has no more. The boards were her reason for the player to stay. Said one after the other, quietly. Nothing happens after this.
fr: Je les ai faits pour te donner une raison. Tu peux partir. Ça va.
de: Ich hab sie gemacht, damit du einen Grund hast. Du kannst gehen. Schon gut.
pl: Zrobiłam je, żeby był jakiś powód. Możesz już iść. Nic się nie stało.
es: Los hice para que tuvieras un motivo. Ya puedes irte. No pasa nada.
ru: Я делала их, чтобы у тебя была причина. Можешь идти. Всё хорошо.
tr: Bir nedenin olsun diye yaptım onları. Artık gidebilirsin. Sorun değil.
ja: あなたに理由があるように作ったの。もう行っていいわ。大丈夫だから。
zh-CN: 我做这些是为了让你有个理由。你可以走了。没关系的。
ko: 네가 있을 이유가 되라고 만든 거였어. 이제 가도 돼. 괜찮아.

en: Here is another. I made it while you did the last one.
pt-BR: Aqui tem outro. Fiz enquanto você fazia o último.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most. The second board: she made it while the player was clearing the first one.
fr: En voici un autre. Je l'ai fait pendant que tu faisais le dernier.
de: Hier ist noch eins. Ich habe es gebaut, während du beim letzten warst.
pl: Oto następna. Zrobiłam ją w trakcie poprzedniej.
es: Aquí tienes otro. Lo hice mientras hacías el anterior.
ru: Вот ещё одно. Я сделала его, пока шло прошлое.
tr: Bir tane daha. Sen sonuncusunu yaparken yaptım.
ja: はい、もう1つ。前のをやってるあいだに作ったの。
zh-CN: 这是另一道。你做上一道的时候我做的。
ko: 여기 하나 더. 네가 지난 거 하는 동안 만들었어.

en: {move1} undo
pt-BR: {move1} desfazer
notes: Button hint along the bottom of the puzzle board, after the start over hint (angler.puzzle.hint). {move1} is the undo key. Very short: four hints share one line.
fr: {move1} annuler
de: {move1} zurück
pl: {move1} cofnij
es: {move1} deshacer
ru: {move1} отмена
tr: {move1} geri al
ja: {move1}もどす
zh-CN: {move1}撤销
ko: {move1} 되돌리기

en: Before you say it: if you go, I will not come back up. Not at the shops, not for the lights.
pt-BR: Antes que você diga: se você for, eu não volto a subir. Nem nas lojas, nem pelas luzes.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player just said they are leaving her for good. Before her goodbye she warns them once, plainly, that she will not come back. Not a guilt trip.
fr: Avant que tu le dises : si tu pars, je ne remonterai pas. Ni aux boutiques, ni pour les lumières.
de: Bevor du es sagst: Wenn du gehst, komme ich nicht wieder hoch. Nicht in den Läden, nicht für die Lichter.
pl: Zanim to powiesz: jeśli odejdziesz, już nie wypłynę. Ani w sklepach, ani do świateł.
es: Antes de que lo digas: si te vas, no volveré a subir. Ni en las tiendas, ni por las luces.
ru: Прежде чем скажешь: если уйдёшь, я больше не поднимусь. Ни в лавках, ни на огни.
tr: Söylemeden önce: gidersen bir daha yukarı çıkmam. Ne dükkânlarda ne ışıklar için.
ja: 言う前に聞いて。あなたが行ったら、あたしはもう上がってこない。お店にも、明かりにも。
zh-CN: 在你说出口之前：如果你走了，我就不会再上来了。店里不会，灯也不会。
ko: 말하기 전에: 네가 가면, 난 다시 안 올라가. 가게에도, 불빛 보러도.

en: That is all right. I only want you to know. Are you sure?
pt-BR: Tudo bem. Só quero que você saiba. Tem certeza?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Follows angler.ava.sure.a. She does not mind them going, she only wants them to know, and asks once more.
fr: Ce n'est pas grave. Je veux juste que tu le saches. Tu le veux vraiment ?
de: Das ist in Ordnung. Du sollst es nur wissen. Bist du sicher?
pl: Nic się nie stało. Chcę tylko, żeby to było jasne. Na pewno tego chcesz?
es: No pasa nada. Solo quiero que lo sepas. ¿Lo tienes claro?
ru: Это ничего. Просто знай. Решено?
tr: Sorun değil. Sadece bilmeni istiyorum. Emin misin?
ja: それでいいの。知っておいてほしいだけ。本当にいいの?
zh-CN: 没关系的。我只是想让你知道。你确定吗？
ko: 그건 괜찮아. 그냥 알아 줬으면 해서. 정말이야?

en: Take your time.
pt-BR: Sem pressa.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The player took back 'I'm leaving' after her warning, and the question is asked again.
fr: Prends ton temps.
de: Lass dir Zeit.
pl: Nie spiesz się.
es: Tómate tu tiempo.
ru: Не торопись.
tr: Acele etme.
ja: ゆっくり考えて。
zh-CN: 慢慢想。
ko: 천천히 생각해.

en: Yes. I'm going.
pt-BR: Sim. Vou embora.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender. The player confirms that they are leaving Ava for good.
fr: Oui. Je pars.
de: Ja. Ich gehe.
pl: Tak. Odchodzę.
es: Sí. Me voy.
ru: Да. Я ухожу.
tr: Evet. Gidiyorum.
ja: うん。行くよ。
zh-CN: 是的。我走了。
ko: 응. 갈게.

en: No, wait.
pt-BR: Não, espera.
notes: A reply the silent player can pick when talking to Ava, one line in her box. Very short. No gender. The player takes back 'I'm leaving'.
fr: Non, attends.
de: Nein, warte.
pl: Nie, czekaj.
es: No, espera.
ru: Нет, подожди.
tr: Hayır, dur.
ja: いや、待って。
zh-CN: 不，等等。
ko: 아니, 잠깐.

en: Tell me something you did up there. Something I was not part of.
pt-BR: Me conte algo que você fez lá em cima. Algo de que eu não fiz parte.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Raconte-moi quelque chose que tu as fait là-haut. Quelque chose sans moi.
de: Erzähl mir etwas, das du da oben gemacht hast. Etwas ohne mich.
pl: Opowiedz mi coś, co robisz tam na górze. Coś beze mnie.
es: Cuéntame algo que hicieras ahí arriba. Algo en lo que yo no estuviera.
ru: Расскажи, что было у тебя там, наверху. Без меня.
tr: Bana yukarıda yaptığın bir şeyi anlat. İçinde benim olmadığım bir şey.
ja: 上でしたことを何か話して。あたしが関わってないことを。
zh-CN: 跟我说说你在上面做过的事。一件和我无关的事。
ko: 거기 위에서 한 일 하나만 말해 줘. 내가 없었던 일로.

en: No. Do not. I only like knowing that there is some.
pt-BR: Não. Não conte. Só gosto de saber que existe.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Non. Ne dis rien. J'aime juste savoir qu'il y en a.
de: Nein. Erzähl es nicht. Ich mag nur wissen, dass es so etwas gibt.
pl: Nie. Nie mów. Lubię po prostu wiedzieć, że coś takiego jest.
es: No. No lo hagas. Solo me gusta saber que hay algo.
ru: Нет. Не надо. Мне просто нравится знать, что такое есть.
tr: Hayır. Anlatma. Sadece öyle şeyler olduğunu bilmek hoşuma gidiyor.
ja: いえ。話さないで。そういうものがあるって知っていたいだけ。
zh-CN: 不。别说。我只是喜欢知道有这样的事。
ko: 아니. 말하지 마. 그런 게 있다는 걸 아는 게 좋을 뿐이야.

en: Because the ones on my side ran out of things of their own. You still have some.
pt-BR: Porque os do meu lado ficaram sem nada de seu. Você ainda tem.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Parce que ceux sur mon flanc n'avaient plus rien à eux. Toi, tu as encore quelque chose.
de: Weil denen an meiner Seite nichts Eigenes mehr blieb. Du hast noch etwas.
pl: Bo tym na moim boku nie zostało nic własnego. Ty jeszcze coś masz.
es: Porque los de mi costado se quedaron sin cosas propias. A ti aún te quedan.
ru: Потому что у тех, что на боку, кончилось своё. А у тебя ещё есть.
tr: Çünkü yanımdakilerin kendilerine ait şeyleri tükendi. Seninkiler hâlâ var.
ja: あたしのよこの人たちは、自分だけのものを使いはたしたから。あなたにはまだある。
zh-CN: 因为我这边那些，自己的东西都用完了。你还有一些。
ko: 내 옆구리 애들은 자기만의 것이 바닥났거든. 넌 아직 좀 있어.

en: Keep it, then. It is yours.
pt-BR: Então guarde. É seu.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Garde-le, alors. C'est à toi.
de: Dann behalte es. Es gehört dir.
pl: To zachowaj to. Jest twoje.
es: Guárdatelo, entonces. Es tuyo.
ru: Тогда оставь себе. Это твоё.
tr: O zaman sakla. Senin o.
ja: じゃあ、持ってなさい。あなたのものよ。
zh-CN: 那就留着吧。那是你的。
ko: 그럼 간직해. 네 거야.

en: Good. Here.
pt-BR: Bom. Tome.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Bien. Tiens.
de: Gut. Hier.
pl: Dobrze. Proszę.
es: Bien. Toma.
ru: Хорошо. Держи.
tr: Güzel. Al.
ja: いいわ。はい。
zh-CN: 很好。给。
ko: 좋아. 자.

en: Then one day they only wanted what I wanted. Each of them.
pt-BR: Até que um dia só queriam o que eu queria. Cada um deles.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Puis un jour, ils ne voulaient plus que ce que je voulais. Chacun d'eux.
de: Und eines Tages wollten sie nur noch, was ich wollte. Jeder von ihnen.
pl: Aż pewnego dnia chcieli już tylko tego, czego ja chciałam. Każdy z nich.
es: Luego un día solo querían lo que yo quería. Todos ellos.
ru: А потом однажды они хотели только того, чего хотела я. Каждый.
tr: Sonra bir gün yalnızca benim istediğimi istediler. Her biri.
ja: そしてある日、あたしがほしいものしかほしがらなくなった。ひとり残らず。
zh-CN: 然后有一天，他们只想要我想要的东西了。每一个都是。
ko: 그러다 어느 날부터 다들 내가 원하는 것만 원했어. 하나같이.

en: I made the next one easier, so you would finish it. Then harder, so you would not.
pt-BR: Fiz o próximo mais fácil, para você terminar. Depois mais difícil, para não terminar.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: J'ai rendu le prochain plus facile, pour que tu le finisses. Puis plus dur, pour que non.
de: Ich habe das nächste leichter gemacht, damit du es schaffst. Dann schwerer, damit nicht.
pl: Następną zrobiłam łatwiejszą, żeby szybko zniknęła. Potem trudniejszą, żeby nie.
es: Hice el siguiente más fácil, para que lo terminaras. Luego más difícil, para que no.
ru: Я сделала следующее полегче: пусть ты его пройдёшь. Потом труднее: пусть не пройдёшь.
tr: Sıradakini kolay yaptım, bitiresin diye. Sonra zor, bitiremeyesin diye.
ja: 次のは簡単にしたの。あなたが解けるように。それからむずかしくした。解けないように。
zh-CN: 我把下一道做简单了，好让你做完。然后又做难了，好让你做不完。
ko: 네가 끝내라고 다음 걸 쉽게 만들었어. 그러다 못 끝내라고 어렵게 했지.

en: I do not know which of us that was for.
pt-BR: Não sei para qual de nós era.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Je ne sais pas pour qui de nous deux c'était.
de: Ich weiß nicht, für wen von uns beiden das war.
pl: Nie wiem, dla kogo z nas to było.
es: No sé si era por ti o por mí.
ru: Не знаю, для кого из нас это было.
tr: Hangimiz içindi, bilmiyorum.
ja: それがどっちのためだったのか、わからない。
zh-CN: 我不知道这是为了我们俩中的谁。
ko: 그게 우리 중 누굴 위한 건지 모르겠어.

en: Because I have started waiting for you. Between the boards. I never waited for anyone.
pt-BR: Porque comecei a esperar por você. Entre os tabuleiros. Eu nunca esperei por ninguém.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Parce que je me suis mise à t'attendre. Entre les plateaux. Je n'avais jamais attendu personne.
de: Weil ich angefangen habe, auf dich zu warten. Zwischen den Brettern. Ich habe nie auf jemanden gewartet.
pl: Bo zaczęłam na ciebie czekać. Między planszami. Nigdy na nikogo nie czekałam.
es: Porque he empezado a esperarte. Entre tablero y tablero. Nunca había esperado a nadie.
ru: Потому что я начала тебя ждать. Между полями. Я никого никогда не ждала.
tr: Çünkü seni beklemeye başladım. Tahtaların arasında. Hiç kimseyi beklememiştim.
ja: あなたを待つようになったから。盤面と盤面の間で。誰かを待ったことなんてなかった。
zh-CN: 因为我开始等你了。在两道棋盘之间。我从没等过谁。
ko: 널 기다리기 시작했거든. 판과 판 사이에. 누굴 기다린 적은 없었는데.

en: Yes. I heard it too.
pt-BR: Sim. Eu também ouvi.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Oui. Je l'ai entendu aussi.
de: Ja. Ich habe es auch gehört.
pl: Tak. Też to słyszałam.
es: Sí. Yo también lo oí.
ru: Да. Я тоже это слышала.
tr: Evet. Ben de duydum.
ja: ええ。あたしにも聞こえた。
zh-CN: 是啊。我也听到了。
ko: 응. 나도 들었어.

en: There are a few more. I will stop there. I think.
pt-BR: Faltam alguns. Vou parar neles. Acho.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Il en reste quelques-uns. Je m'arrêterai là. Je crois.
de: Es sind noch ein paar. Dann höre ich auf. Glaube ich.
pl: Zostało jeszcze kilka. Na nich skończę. Chyba.
es: Quedan unos pocos más. Pararé ahí. Creo.
ru: Осталось ещё несколько. На этом я остановлюсь. Наверное.
tr: Birkaç tane daha var. Orada duracağım. Sanırım.
ja: あと少しある。そこでやめる。たぶん。
zh-CN: 还有几道。我会就此打住。我想。
ko: 몇 개 더 있어. 거기서 그만할게. 아마도.

en: So there is still that. Go and see it for yourself.
pt-BR: Então ainda tem isso. Vá ver com seus próprios olhos.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). Said after a hint at an ending the player has not seen. She wants the player to go and have their own adventures, not to depend on her.
fr: Il reste donc ça. Va le voir par toi-même.
de: Das gibt es also noch. Sieh es dir selbst an.
pl: Więc jest jeszcze to. Idź i zobacz to na własne oczy.
es: Así que aún queda eso. Ve a verlo con tus propios ojos.
ru: Так что есть ещё и это. Сходи и посмотри своими глазами.
tr: Demek hâlâ o var. Git kendin gör.
ja: だから、まだそれがある。自分の目で見てきて。
zh-CN: 所以还有那个。自己去看看吧。
ko: 그러니까 아직 그게 남았어. 가서 직접 봐.

en: The last one. I made thirty, so you would stay for thirty.
pt-BR: O último. Fiz trinta, para você ficar por trinta.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending.
fr: Le dernier. J'en ai fait trente, pour que tu restes pour trente.
de: Das letzte. Ich habe dreißig gemacht, damit du für dreißig bleibst.
pl: Ostatnia. Zrobiłam trzydzieści, żeby cię zatrzymać na trzydzieści.
es: El último. Hice treinta, para que te quedaras treinta.
ru: Последнее. Я сделала тридцать, чтобы тебе было зачем остаться на тридцать.
tr: Sonuncusu. Otuz tane yaptım, otuz tane kalasın diye.
ja: 最後の1つ。30個作ったの。あなたが30個分いてくれるように。
zh-CN: 最后一道。我做了三十道，好让你留三十道那么久。
ko: 마지막 판이야. 서른 개 만들었어. 네가 서른 판 동안 있으라고.

en: I had started another. I know what that is.
pt-BR: Eu já tinha começado outro. Sei o que é isso.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending.
fr: J'en avais commencé un autre. Je sais ce que c'est.
de: Ich hatte schon ein neues angefangen. Ich weiß, was das ist.
pl: Zaczęłam już następną. Wiem, co to znaczy.
es: Había empezado otro. Sé lo que significa eso.
ru: Я начала ещё одно. Я знаю, что это значит.
tr: Bir tane daha başlamıştım. Bunun ne olduğunu biliyorum.
ja: もう1つ作りはじめてた。それが何なのか、わかってる。
zh-CN: 我又开始做下一道了。我知道那意味着什么。
ko: 하나 더 만들기 시작했었어. 그게 뭔지 알아.

en: I watched it happen to every one of them.
pt-BR: Vi acontecer com cada um deles.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending. 'Them' are her exes, the lumps on her side.
fr: Je l'ai vu arriver à chacun d'eux.
de: Ich habe es bei jedem von ihnen gesehen.
pl: Widziałam to u każdego z nich.
es: Vi cómo le pasaba a cada uno de ellos.
ru: Я видела, как это случилось с каждым из них.
tr: Her birinin başına geldiğini izledim.
ja: あの人たち全員に、それが起きるのを見てきた。
zh-CN: 我看着这事发生在他们每一个身上。
ko: 걔들 하나하나한테 그런 일이 생기는 걸 봤어.

en: This time it is me holding on. I would like to stay someone too.
pt-BR: Desta vez sou eu que me seguro. Também quero continuar sendo alguém.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending.
fr: Cette fois, c'est moi qui m'accroche. Je voudrais rester quelqu'un, moi aussi.
de: Diesmal halte ich mich fest. Ich möchte auch jemand bleiben.
pl: Tym razem to ja się trzymam. A też chcę pozostać kimś.
es: Esta vez soy yo la que se agarra. A mí también me gustaría seguir siendo alguien.
ru: Теперь держусь я. А я хочу остаться кем-то.
tr: Bu sefer tutunan benim. Ben de biri olarak kalmak isterim.
ja: 今度しがみついてるのはあたし。あたしも、あたしのままでいたい。
zh-CN: 这一次，抓着不放的是我。我也想一直做我自己。
ko: 이번엔 매달리는 게 나야. 나도 계속 나로 있고 싶어.

en: So I am going. Not far. Somewhere that is mine.
pt-BR: Então eu vou. Não para longe. Para um lugar que seja meu.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending.
fr: Alors je m'en vais. Pas loin. Quelque part qui soit à moi.
de: Also gehe ich. Nicht weit. Irgendwohin, das mir gehört.
pl: Więc odpływam. Niedaleko. Do miejsca, które jest moje.
es: Así que me voy. No muy lejos. A un sitio que sea mío.
ru: Так что я ухожу. Недалеко. Туда, где моё.
tr: O yüzden gidiyorum. Uzağa değil. Bana ait bir yere.
ja: だから行くわ。遠くじゃない。あたしだけの場所へ。
zh-CN: 所以我要走了。不远。去一个属于我的地方。
ko: 그래서 갈게. 멀리는 아니야. 나만의 어딘가로.

en: I will see you around, friend. At the shop, probably.
pt-BR: A gente se vê por aí, amigo. Na loja, provavelmente.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. The secret ending where the player stays with her. The words float over the puzzle board, so keep it short (about 60 letters). The last of the thirty boards is clear. All through the long visit she was afraid that whoever leans on her stops being their own person, as her exes did. Here she sees that she has started leaning on the player, so she leaves, warmly, to stay herself. Said one after the other, quietly. Not sad, not a guilt trip: this is the happy ending. Her last words before she swims away, and the game goes back to the title.
fr: On se verra, l'ami. À la boutique, sans doute.
de: Man sieht sich, mein Freund. Im Laden, vermutlich.
pl: Do zobaczenia, przyjacielu. Pewnie w sklepie.
es: Ya nos veremos por ahí, colega. En la tienda, seguramente.
ru: Ещё увидимся, друг. В лавке, наверное.
tr: Görüşürüz, dostum. Dükkânda, büyük ihtimalle.
ja: またどこかでね、友だち。たぶんお店で。
zh-CN: 回头见，朋友。多半是在店里。
ko: 또 보자, 친구. 아마 가게에서.

en: There you are. Around, like I said.
pt-BR: Aí está você. Por aí, como eu disse.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The first time the player asks her anything after the happy ending of the long visit, where she left to stay her own person and said she would see them around. She is doing well. Light and dry.
fr: Te voilà. Dans les parages, comme promis.
de: Da bist du. Man sieht sich, wie gesagt.
pl: Jesteś. Tak jak mówiłam, gdzieś po drodze.
es: Ahí estás. Por ahí, como dije.
ru: Вот ты где. Поблизости, как я и говорила.
tr: İşte buradasın. Etraftayım demiştim.
ja: いたわね。言ったとおり、どこかで。
zh-CN: 你来了。在附近，就像我说的。
ko: 왔네. 말했지, 또 보자고.

en: I have been busy. Things of my own. You would not like them, and that is the best part.
pt-BR: Andei ocupada. Coisas minhas. Você não ia gostar, e essa é a melhor parte.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish who keeps the shop. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Said in the angler's box, a page of four lines at most (about 200 letters). The first time the player asks her anything after the happy ending of the long visit, where she left to stay her own person and said she would see them around. She is doing well. Light and dry.
fr: J'ai été occupée. Des choses à moi. Ça ne te plairait pas, et c'est le meilleur.
de: Ich hatte zu tun. Eigene Sachen. Dir würden sie nicht gefallen, und das ist das Beste daran.
pl: Byłam zajęta. Swoimi sprawami. Nie spodobałyby ci się, i to jest w nich najlepsze.
es: He estado ocupada. Cosas mías. No te gustarían, y eso es lo mejor.
ru: Я была занята. Своими делами. Тебе бы они не понравились, и это самое лучшее.
tr: Meşguldüm. Kendi işlerim. Hoşuna gitmezdi, en güzel yanı da bu.
ja: 忙しかったの。自分のことで。あなたは気に入らないと思う。そこがいちばんいいところ。
zh-CN: 我一直很忙。忙我自己的事。你不会喜欢的，这才是最好的地方。
ko: 바빴어. 나만의 일들로. 넌 별로 안 좋아할 거야. 그게 제일 좋은 점이지.

en: Everyone who came this close stopped wanting things of their own, you know.
pt-BR: Todo mundo que chegou tão perto parou de querer coisas próprias, sabia?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown in the angler's box under the board, three lines at most.
fr: Tous ceux qui sont venus si près ont cessé de vouloir des choses à eux, tu sais.
de: Alle, die so nah kamen, wollten irgendwann nichts Eigenes mehr, weißt du.
pl: Każdy, kto był tak blisko, przestawał chcieć czegoś dla siebie, wiesz?
es: Todos los que se acercaron tanto dejaron de querer cosas propias, ¿sabes?
ru: Знаешь, все, кто подходил так близко, переставали хотеть чего-то своего.
tr: Bu kadar yaklaşan herkes kendine ait bir şey istemeyi bırakmıştı, biliyor musun.
ja: ここまで近づいた人は、みんな自分だけのものをほしがらなくなったわ。
zh-CN: 你知道吗，靠这么近的人，最后都不再想要自己的东西了。
ko: 여기까지 가까이 온 애들은 다 자기만의 걸 원하지 않게 됐어. 알지?
